analysis.title: GS Novak - GS U.S. Industrials & Materials | GE | MMM | RTX | GM | NOC and more 20 Oct 2026
key_insights: Desk pre-call view: RTX and VMI trade better, CCK, GPC, GM and MLI worse, GE, MMM and NOC mixed/debated.

GE Q3 EPS $2.25 vs $2.01 consensus on revenue $13.29bn vs $12.88bn. Full-year EPS guidance raised to $8-8.10 from $7.65-7.85 and free cash flow raised to $9.1-9.4bn. Total orders reaccelerated to +49%, but feedback flags a services growth slowdown.
GE expects 2027 commercial services growth in the low double digits, supported by a $170bn commercial service backlog.
CCK Q3 EPS $2.39 vs $2.26 on sales $3.71bn vs $3.46bn. Full-year EPS narrowed to $8.35-8.45 and free cash flow raised to at least $950mm. Implied Q4 of $1.63-1.73 is below the $1.80 consensus.

GM Q3 EPS $3.70 vs $3.56 on revenue $50bn vs $48.78bn consensus. Full-year EPS guidance $12.75-13.75 vs $12-14 prior, and adjusted automotive free cash flow raised to $11.5-12.5bn. Feedback is negative on the implied Q4 coming in below expectations and on flat North America price/mix.
GPC Q3 EPS $2.07 in line with $2.04 consensus. Full-year EPS guidance cut to $7.50-7.75 from $7.50-8.00 prior. North America EBITDA missed.
MLI Q3 EPS $1.00 missed $1.08 consensus despite revenue of $1.42bn vs $1.29bn. EBIT was $282mm vs $287mm.

MMM Q3 EPS $2.50 vs $2.39 on revenue of $6.6bn in line. Full-year EPS guidance raised to $9.10-9.15 from $8.80-8.95. Organic growth of 3.3% was slightly below expectations. Feedback is mixed to negative on the quarter. MMM gave initial 2027 color that momentum from 2H continues.

NOC Q3 EPS $7.89 vs $7.18 on revenue $11.12bn vs $11.14bn. Net awards $16.4bn, book-to-bill 1.5x. Full-year EPS raised to $29.35-29.75. 2027 outlook is sales growth of 5-7%, with further acceleration in 2028. Initial 2027 came in below expectations per feedback.

RTX Q3 EPS $2.26, including $0.25 from IEEPA, on revenue $24.97bn vs $24.11bn. Full-year EPS raised to $7.65-7.75 from $7.10-7.25 and organic growth to +10-11% from +8-9%. Free cash flow guidance raised to $9-9.2bn. Collins, Pratt and Raytheon all beat.
VMI Q3 EPS $6.24 vs $5.70 on revenue $1.1bn vs $1.12bn. EBIT $173mm vs $159mm. Full-year EPS raised to $22.75-23.75. Infrastructure missed on revenue and EBIT.
Implied earnings moves: GE 5%, GPC 4%, GM 5%, MMM 5%, NOC 4%, RTX 4%, VMI 7%.

market_movers.rationale: Desk thinks RTX trades better after a revenue and EPS beat and a raise to full-year EPS, organic growth and free cash flow guidance.
Desk thinks VMI trades better on an EBIT beat of $173mm vs $159mm and a raised full-year EPS range.
Desk thinks CCK trades worse because implied Q4 EPS of $1.63-1.73 is below the $1.80 consensus, despite a Q3 beat.
Desk thinks GPC trades worse after the full-year EPS range was cut at the top end and North America EBITDA missed.
Desk thinks GM trades worse on an implied Q4 below expectations and flat North America price/mix, despite a Q3 beat.
Desk thinks MLI trades worse after a Q3 EPS miss of $1.00 vs $1.08.
Desk calls GE mixed/debated. Total orders and guidance are better, but services growth is slowing.
Desk calls MMM mixed/debated with negative feedback on the quarter, despite a raised full-year EPS range.
Desk calls NOC mixed/debated. The quarter and guide are better, but the initial 2027 outlook is below expectations.

CCK Q3 EPS $2.39 reported vs consensus $2.26, printed 10/19 post-market. Sales $3.71bn vs $3.46bn. Full-year EPS $8.35-8.45 vs $8.30-8.50 prior. Implied Q4 EPS $1.63-1.73 vs $1.80 consensus.

GPC Q3 EPS $2.07 vs consensus $2.04, printed 10/20. Revenue $6.5bn in line. Comps +2.9%. Full-year EPS guidance $7.50-7.75 vs $7.50-8.00 prior. Revenue growth guide of 3-5.5% reaffirmed vs 5% consensus.

GM Q3 EPS $3.70 vs consensus $3.56, printed 10/20. Revenue $50bn vs $48.78bn consensus. EBIT $4.11bn in line. Full-year EPS $12.75-13.75 vs $12-14 prior. Full-year EBIT $14.5-15.5bn vs $14-16bn prior.
MLI Q3 EPS $1.00 vs consensus $1.08, printed 10/20. Revenue $1.42bn vs $1.29bn. EBIT $282mm vs $287mm.

MMM Q3 EPS $2.50 vs consensus $2.39, printed 10/20. Revenue $6.6bn in line. Organic growth 3.3%. Full-year EPS guidance $9.10-9.15 vs $8.80-8.95 prior. Safety and Industrial margin 30.2% vs 28.1%, Transportation and Electronics margin 23.4% vs 24.3% consensus, Consumer margin 23% vs 22.2%.

NOC Q3 EPS $7.89 vs consensus $7.18, printed 10/20. Revenue $11.12bn vs $11.14bn. Net awards $16.4bn, book-to-bill 1.5x. Full-year EPS $29.35-29.75 vs $28.60-29.10 prior. Segment income $4.94-5.04bn vs $4.85-5bn prior. 2027 free cash flow range $3.3-3.7bn and segment margin expansion of 10-20bps.
RTX Q3 EPS $2.26 reported, including $0.25 from IEEPA, printed 10/20. Revenue $24.97bn vs $24.11bn. Full-year EPS $7.65-7.75 vs $7.10-7.25 prior. Full-year revenue $97-97.5bn vs $95-96bn prior.
VMI Q3 EPS $6.24 vs consensus $5.70, printed 10/20. Revenue $1.1bn vs $1.12bn. EBIT $173mm vs $159mm. Full-year EPS $22.75-23.75 vs $22.25-23.50 prior. Full-year revenue $4.3-4.45bn reaffirmed.
